mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls simultaneously and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both decline and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a more restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% in 1 month during a tightening cycle and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
